alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 8 at 12:10AM PST until November 10 at 12:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Minor to locally moderate coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until noon PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of parking lots and roads with only isolated
road closures expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest tides will occur in the late
morning each day, peaking at 7.4-7.6 feet today and Monday,
which is 1.3 to 1.6 feet above astronomical tide predictions.
Surf will increase slightly Monday, which may prolong some of
the coastal impacts.
